scope: external real-video transfer check; existing offline estimator plus separately trained A/B estimators
dataset: GigaHands five official demo sequences; CC BY-NC 4.0; markerless capture-derived annotations
selection: one camera per each of five demo sessions, chosen before inference to maximize the share of annotated palm centers within the fixed center disk; this is a mask-focused convenience sample, not a random benchmark split
reference: GigaHands per-frame 2D keypoint JSONL; transformed with the same aspect-preserving contain geometry; labels with confidence <= 0 omitted

metrics.primary_position: 2D MPJPE (mean per-joint Euclidean distance), pixel and palm-normalized; conditional on finite detected predictions
metrics.pck: PCK@0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.50 palm lengths; misses count incorrect over all labeled joints
metrics.pck_auc: normalized trapezoidal area under PCK on [0, 0.50] palm lengths; not the CrossFuNet 20-50 mm 3D interval
metrics.temporal_accuracy: GT-relative mean per-joint acceleration error, second finite difference times fps^2; px/s^2 and palm-length/s^2; complete detected GT triplets only
metrics.temporal_stability: VERA-Hand release-code Jacc/Jjerk/Ev on prediction-only image-relative coordinates, kept separate from GT accuracy
metrics.other_custom_summaries: 20 bone-length absolute differences; 15-triple 2D angle absolute error in degrees; by-finger and by-joint-type subsets
metrics.occlusion_strata: hidden/visible joints, mask-coverage levels, and contiguous occlusion duration bins; these are subgroups of base metrics
metrics.missed_predictions: excluded from valid-output MPJPE/acceleration but retained as failures in PCK and in separately reported detection failure

prod_score_comparison.method: exact landmark angle triples, wrist/palm-normalized trajectory, 1.2x target resample and sliding offset window for the component named DTW, second differences for accel, detection-rate scaling, MX and W2 thresholds/weights
prod_score_comparison.scope_note: computed as a whole-clip model-vs-GigaHands-reference analog; not an actual CAPTCHA session, participant result, or pass-rate claim

timing.device: CPU only; model initialization/warm-up and shared video decode/transform reported separately
